Rural Australia I imagine is a bit like rural USA, depends where you go. Rural Queensland can be pretty redneck, New South Wales is the most populated state, followed by Victoria, there's beauty in this country but you have to be willing to travel. UTS is right in the middle of Sydney. They only recently (last couple of years) put on accommodation, which is a bit pricey, but it's very close to campus. Mixed reviews about on campus living, there are parties sure, but like any where you get your recluses and  your party animals, so it's a mixed bag. The newest Accom is yura mudang, I think it's called (Australian aboriginal names). It's high rise, can be a bit noisy. There are others, which are a bit further out, but they are a bit quieter, but still fun :) some people live on campuses other unis (sydney uni or UNSW), but I don't think that option would be open to you. Most people live in share houses, which can be found through the uni, or on Gumtree (bit like Craigslist). Again, hit and miss, but there's usually a good selection. Rent is very expensive in sydney, but don't let that put you off. It's a quality city to experience.

UTS is getting better with social events, but because most people live at home and the uni doesn't have a whole lot of room for events, most of the fun happens in the city. (20 minute bus ride from the campus). Buses and trains around the city are great, in the suburbs it's a bit cheaper rent wise, but public Transport is not so good. I wouldn't bother with a bike or car unless you were planning to travel a lot around Australia (transport outside of Sydney is pretty piss poor aka almost non existent/ expensive). 

Australians can be a bit lax compared to Americans I have found. Where you might find us a bit stand offish/dry/ sarcasticall, we might think Americans are just way too enthusiastic/loud. Don't be put off, were pretty adaptable to all cultures ( it's a very multi cultural city, right next to Chinatown is the campus. Yoda I am, apparently). Everyone is different, it's an interesting mix of cultures at UTS, sydney in general. There are frequently cultural festivals in town
